topic: How Fees and Expenses Affect Your Investment Portfolio
source_evidence: The commission compensates the investment professional and his or her firm when it is acting as an agent for you in your securities transaction. When acting as a principal, the broker-dealer generally will be compensated by selling the security to you at a price that is higher than the market price (the difference is called a markup), or by buying the security from you at a price that is lower than the market price (the difference is called a markdown).
answer: Commissions and markups or markdowns are transaction fees, but they work differently. A commission compensates an investment professional and firm acting as your agent in a securities transaction. A markup or markdown applies when a broker-dealer trades with you from its own inventory as a principal: a markup is the amount by which the sale price to you is above the market price, while a markdown is the amount by which the purchase price from you is below the market price. These transaction fees reduce the overall amount of money in your portfolio.
